title: Atta, Faire Language (AZT) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map ...
text: Faire Atta is an endangered indigenous language of the Philippines. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. The language is used as a first language by all adults in the ethnic community, but not all young people. It is not known to be taught in schools.

title: Atta, Faire - Department of Linguistics - UP Diliman
text: Atta, Faire is deemed very similar to languages such as Atta, Pudtol [atp], Agta, Central Cagayan [agt], and Isnag [isd]. It is used at home by adults and some young people, and its speakers also use related languages like Atta, Pamplona [att] and Ibanag [ibg].
